title: kate-core: keep a quote after a backslash plain
summary: A quote typed after a backslash stays a plain insert. A parenthesis after a backslash still wraps. The test goes in the existing pair tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn quote_stays_plain(buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer, selection: crate::Selection, ch: char) -> bool

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: pair.rs is a private module of fanout.rs. Its one test module is mod tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Replace the body of quote_stays_plain with this exact body. If is_quote(ch) is false, return false. Then use let-else, not a match: let Some(prev) = char_before(buf, selection.min()) else { return false; }; Return prev == '\\' || is_ascii_word(prev). Do not rewrite char_before. It already uses the ? operator. Do not touch plan_pair, is_type_over, is_opener, is_closer, is_quote, closer_for, one_scalar, or char_at. The test a_quote_after_a_backslash_stays_plain uses TextBuffer::from_str of one backslash and a caret at Offset(1). plan_pair of a double quote, a single quote, and a backtick each returns PairPlan::Plain. plan_pair of an open parenthesis returns PairPlan::Wrap with caret_after_open true. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: fanout::pair::tests::a_quote_after_a_backslash_stays_plain
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A quote after a backslash returns Wrap. After the change a double quote, a single quote, and a backtick return Plain. An open parenthesis still returns Wrap with caret_after_open true.
